text: Attempt 5 begins. Fire first: no tree parks in any plan, rubble cleared, every run stops on new rubble, airport in the empty north-east corner far from homes. Build order as attempt 4.

Attempt 5 started. Four tries so far: three were burned down by great fires, all four ran out of money. This time the plan is to survive fires first: no tree parks, quick firebreaks, and an airport far from homes.
Feb 2001: loan #2, district a20-2003 built; the 2002 plan (coal plant + north riverbank pumps) ran out of cash part-way - finish it with loan #3.
